about: Every stage of both datasets, in dependency order. scripts/pipeline.py reads this file; docs/DATA_LINEAGE.md explains it. Paths are relative to the repository root. 'inputs' and 'code' are hashed into pipeline/pipeline.lock.json when a stage is built; a stage is stale when any of them changed since. 'config' lists curated settings files (hashed like code).

kinds.source: the data everything else is built from; corrected only through the tools in edited_by
kinds.recorded: built once outside this orchestrator (model calls, or inputs that are not committed); its committed outputs are the record
kinds.check: a check run by hand; never marked fresh without being run
kinds.runtime: something that runs live (a gateway, a replay server); has evidence, not build outputs

rebuild_modes.source: accepted as it is (hashed) when a rebuild starts from it
rebuild_modes.auto: run by scripts/pipeline.py rebuild when its requires are present
rebuild_modes.recorded: never re-run here; accepted as it is only when a rebuild starts from it or --accept-recorded is given
rebuild_modes.manual: never run here; the command is printed

stages.title: Data state & confidence assessment: the TE seed model
stages.treatment: Hand-transcribed from Downs & Vogel (1993); tag numbers assigned by this project, the XMEAS/XMV index kept on every item. Every item carries verification.status, and ops_review once someone reviews it.
stages.carries: verification.status per item (source check); ops_review.status and reviewer; open_question
stages.checked_by: scripts/verify_te_source.py against teprob.f (instruments and final elements only on this branch)

stages.title: Source check report: the model against the simulator code
stages.requires_note: downloads teprob.f into data/external/te-braatz/ if it is not cached (network)
stages.treatment: Compares each instrument and final element's description and units with the simulator source; report only (no --write).
stages.carries: writes the verification.status the model then carries (with --write)
stages.checked_by: the script itself, line by line against teprob.f

stages.title: Platform exports: Ignition tags, PI AF sheet, SVGs, operations review sheet
stages.treatment: One model, every format: structural validation first, nothing written on failure.
stages.carries: Ignition tag documentation and PI attribute descriptions end with '| source check: <status> | ops review: <status>'; the review sheet's model_status and OPS_ columns
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_generate_validation.py, scripts/test_apply_review.py (offline); the PI sheet has never been imported into a PI System

stages.title: Overview mimic layout (offline)
stages.treatment: Renders the overview with the same function the Ignition build uses and keeps, per reading: the unit it is drawn beside, where, and the tag path it reads.
stages.carries: each reading: the provenance of its model item; positions and the choice of readings are first-pass display choices
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_process_mimic.py, scripts/test_pipeline.py; the full screens were checked in a disposable gateway (README); not reviewed by operations

stages.title: 3D scene data and inferred LOTO candidates
stages.treatment: Equipment, tags, ownership and stream ends copied from the model; positions are the 2D layout scaled; sizes, elevations and pipe routes are placeholders; LOTO candidates are inferred (valves on streams touching a unit).
stages.carries: every unit, tag, pipe and LOTO candidate: the provenance of its model item; geometry is marked placeholder; LOTO is marked inferred and not a procedure
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_pipeline.py (that it follows the model). The 3D renderer itself is a separate, unpublished prototype; its stills are in drafts/3d-tour/

stages.title: Learned normal bands from the recorded normal run
stages.requires_note: hash-verified TE replay files: python scripts/fetch_te_data.py (network)
stages.treatment: Mean +/- K standard deviations on the first half of the normal run; K chosen on the second half; the fault run chooses nothing.
stages.carries: statistics on published data; one operating mode assumed
stages.checked_by: the held-out half of the normal run and the fault-6 run (docs/OPERATOR_SCREENS.md)

stages.title: Data state & confidence assessment: the 12 OPEN100 drawings and their answer keys
stages.treatment: Third-party drawings with third-party answer keys (symbol classes, boxes, connections; no tag text). Sheets 0-5 are the development set, 6-11 the sealed holdout A.
stages.carries: answer keys are the ground truth for symbols and connections only
stages.checked_by: the PID2Graph authors; the scorer's positive and negative controls (scripts/test_scorer_controls.py)

stages.title: Extraction: models read symbols and tags (2x2 tiles), code traces the lines
stages.requires_note: model calls (sends drawings to the selected service); run records are not committed (runs/README.md)
stages.treatment: Method M3, chosen by a rule written before the holdouts were scored.
stages.carries: per item: the model's confidence and the source run; scored per set against the answer keys

stages.title: Scorecards against the answer keys
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed)
stages.treatment: Rules fixed before any run; failures count as zero.
stages.carries: set-level accuracy (review load, F1 by class); it does not say which individual item is right
stages.checked_by: scripts/test_scorer_controls.py (the scorer must fail deliberately wrong answers)

stages.title: Asset model: sheets to hierarchy, risk-tiered review queue
stages.requires_note: the run records under runs/ (not committed); after building, review decisions are applied to this file in place
stages.treatment: Deterministic conversion; every item starts unverified, gets a risk tier and a plain-language reason. Review corrections and I/O mappings are then applied to this file by the edited_by tools.
stages.checked_by: scripts/score_twin.py (parent assignment), scripts/score_triage.py (risk tiers) on the holdouts

stages.title: Platform exports: review queue, Ignition tags, PI AF sheet, SVG overlays
stages.treatment: Same generator as TE; signal paths are placeholders, never invented.
stages.carries: Ignition documentation and PI descriptions carry the item's confidence and 'UNVERIFIED'; the review queue carries tier, reason and status

stages.title: Ignition gateway kit: tag provider, alarms, 23-view Perspective project (mimic and sheet screens)
local_outputs: out/ignition/gateway/PIDTwin.zip (regenerated locally; the committed ZIP is the older historical export)
stages.requires_note: hash-verified TE replay files: python scripts/fetch_te_data.py (network). Writes files only; no gateway is contacted
stages.treatment: TE tags with published alarm setpoints and learned bands; the extracted twin as placeholders that read 'not connected'; ReviewStatus member on every tag.
stages.carries: a ReviewStatus member per tag (ops review); placeholders stay Bad quality, never a false Good
stages.checked_by: scripts/ignition/verify_gateway.py V1-V8 with planted faults in a disposable gateway (lab result, not site acceptance)

stages.title: Live replay: recorded TE runs drive the gateway
stages.requires_note: a running Ignition 8.3 gateway (docs/IGNITION_BUILD.md) and the TE replay files
stages.treatment: Replays recorded simulator output; it is not a process simulator and does not respond to control changes.
stages.carries: recorded values only; the alarm setpoints are published ones
stages.checked_by: verify_gateway.py V8 (the pressure alarm fires on the replayed fault)
